commercial_use_analysis.explicit_license_text_position: The official 2003 License Agreement text in Section 3 permits redistribution and use with or without modification subject to conditions (a) through (f). commercial_use_analysis.historical_context: NECTEC historically provided bespoke technology transfer agreements for commercial standalone desktop software in the late 1990s and early 2000s, which gave rise to informal assertions that LEXiTRON was non-commercial. However, the published dataset license file (LICENSE.txt) is a modified BSD-style permissive attribution agreement.
